refListTitle: Breadcrumbs in the block reference list
refListDesc: Show the heading chain of each block in the block reference search list
searchListDesc: Show the heading chain of each block in the search panel result list
markerDesc: Symbol shown before each heading name
separatorDesc: Symbol shown between two heading levels
includeSelfDesc: When the block itself is a heading, show it as the last level; turn off to show only the headings above it
truncateDesc: Cut an over-long heading name and mark the cut with an ellipsis
maxLengthDesc: Characters kept per heading name, each level is truncated on its own
